data.long_meaning: The name Maynord is derived from the Old English words ‘maegen’, meaning ‘power’, and ‘norðan’, meaning ‘north’. This name was likely given to a warrior or protector in Anglo-Saxon society. The name Maynord carries the meaning “Powerful protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maynord usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maynord total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maynord has a strong cultural significance as it reflects the history and values of the Anglo-Saxon society. The name 'Maynord' indicates a person who was considered a strong and powerful protector or warrior in the Northern regions. The name exudes a sense of strength and courage, which may have been valuable traits for survival and protection in the harsh and unforgiving northern climate.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Maynord can be seen through its connection to the power of God. The Old English word 'maegen' meaning 'power' can be interpreted as a reflection of the divine power that Christians believe God possesses. Furthermore, the name Maynord may serve as a reminder of the spiritual power that lies within each individual. As a bearer of this name, one may be inspired to use their strength and courage to uphold righteousness, protect the innocent, and embody the love and compassion of God in their daily lives.
